evidence_level: revealed development cross-validation conditional on an oracle ROI
objective: Final 384/512 scale-controller candidate using task-conditioned spatial Patch-Text relevance at the first DeepStack extraction point.

feature_point.text_relevance: maximum cosine similarity from each projected visual group to prompt token embeddings
feature_point.spatial_summary: 4x4 relevance map, seven quantiles, top-8 values and normalized coordinates

stopping_rule: If either task fails the joint gate, stop the current ROI-384/512 scale-controller branch. Do not tune depth, projection, ridge alpha, threshold or feature subsets on this development set.
